description:
Ontological coaching is defined as adjusting your way of "Being" and shifting the way you show up.

Most coaching focuses on what you should do, also known as your "Doings".
Ontological coaching focuses on who you are, your "Being". 

As a world-class coach, Patrick has developed the Emergent Alignment Modality which consists of Conviction → Mission → Vision → Goals. 
By changing who you are being instead of what you doing, your being becomes a conscious choice and then can be aligned. When you start approaching alignment the right behaviors or "doings" follow naturally, leading to you to your goals. 

Patrick's part is to guide in discovering your vision, sort limiting beliefs, and maneuver to complete ownership of who you are and what you want. He brings a fierce advocacy, a powerful healthy disruption and a grounded movement onto what you are striving for.

Catholics and non-religious alike, this methodology is foundational and applicable to all who seek betterment.
Your way of being determines everything you do. Own your being, your life responds.

For a more in-depth understanding visit: OntoCoaching.com

Ontological coaching: adjusting your way of "Being" and shifting the way you show up.

Onto Coaching is a practice that provides world class ontological coaching. It is different from your traditional coach who simply focuses on the things you should do. Anyone can help you come up with a list of to-do items. Instead, ontological coaching targets a foundational shift; instead of the focus being on what you do, the focus is on who you are- your Being.

Patrick Grover is creator and founder of Onto Coaching. He is trained and certified in providing world-class ontological coaching to high performing individuals looking to change their way of being and achieve goals they once believed impossible. Patrick provides guidance in discovering your vision, sorting limiting beliefs, and taking ownership of who you are and what you want. He brings fierce advocacy, powerful healthy disruption, and grounded movement onto what you are striving for.

As a world-class coach, Patrick has developed the Emergent Alignment Modality which consists of: 
Conviction → Mission → Vision → Goals. 
Catholics and non-religious alike, this methodology is foundational and applicable to all who seek betterment. Your way of being determines everything you do. Own your being, your life responds.

For a more in-depth understanding visit: OntoCoaching.com
